messages:
Alex (Partnerships): Heads up — Juno sent final art for the marketplace listing + a draft hero quote for the case study. Can design/marketing/legal do a quick pass today? Link: https://drive.redwood/juno-assets :eyes:
Priya (Design): grabbing assets now. Initial glance: two logo variants, a full-color lockup and a white-on-dark. I'll check clearspace and weight. :ok_hand:
Dmitri (Marketing): I can review hero blurb and recommended callouts. Do we have a preferred tagline length for marketplace hero? 1 sentence or 2?
Alex (Partnerships): Marketplace hero should be 1 short sentence + 1 supporting line. For case study we can expand. Also need alt text and a one-line partner attribution for the co-badge.
Priya (Design): Quick notes after first pass:
- Full-color lockup: needs 16px clearspace at 72dpi equivalent (square logo width x 0.22).
- White lockup: OK but Juno's white mark sits too close to our logo on mobile. Recommend pushing to 110% spacing or stack vertically.
- Color clash: Juno teal (#00A3B5) overlaps our gradient on the hero. Suggest neutral background block behind logos.
Dmitri (Marketing): Thanks. For hero blurb draft from Juno: "Redwood reduced inference latency on Juno's platform by 32%" — Claire, legal: OK to use that kind of performance claim if we attribute?
Claire (Legal): Need backup data and approval from Juno's customer if this references a joint customer. If it's partner-run benchmark, we need the dataset, test plan, and permission to publish numbers. For generic "reduced latency" claims we can use relative phrasing: "observed up to ~32% faster inference in partner tests" pending signoff. Also we need explicit logo usage rights — do we have the Juno logo master license?
Alex (Partnerships): We have a signed co-marketing addendum but it doesn't enumerate exact lockups. I'll ping the partner for confirmation and the benchmark docs.
Priya (Design): Proposed lockup options (copy/paste):
```
Option A (side-by-side, centered): [Redwood] 24px gap [Juno]
Option B (stacked, Juno above): centered, 8px baseline offset, neutral #F7F8FA bar behind
```
Which should I mock in the marketplace thumbnail sizes (512x512, 300x200)?
Dmitri (Marketing): Mock both. Marketplace thumbnails often get auto-cropped — push primary lockup above the fold and include alt text with product focus. Draft alt: "Redwood Inference and Juno Systems logos side-by-side over neutral background; joint marketplace offering." Priya can tweak.
Claire (Legal): Also add alt text that omits customer names and claims. Alt should be descriptive for accessibility only. Good to include partner legal contact email for final sign-off.
AssetBot: Uploaded: juno_lockups_v3.zip (3 files), hero_blurb_draft_v2.docx (1 file) — /drive.redwood/juno-assets (uploaded 2m ago)
Priya (Design): Uploaded two mock thumbnails to the drive path under /mocks/marketplace/ — 512x512 and 300x200. I left a transparent PNG for our CMS.
Dmitri (Marketing): I'll assemble the hero two-liner options for quick A/B in the listing. Option 1: "Run inference faster on Juno — unlock consistent low-latency serving." Option 2: "Optimized LLM inference on Juno hardware with Redwood's serving runtime." Which resonates?
Alex (Partnerships): Both good. Prefer Option 2 for clarity. Also prioritize shorter tagline for mobile.
Claire (Legal): One more: we need to confirm the Juno brand guidelines on co-branding use — specifically allowed color treatments and minimum clearspace. If they require changes that are incompatible, we should provide an alternate artwork.
Priya (Design): I'll prepare an "alternative lockup" guideline PDF for Juno that shows color and mono treatments and suggested CSS snippet for our CMS:
```css
.redwood-juno-lockup { display:inline-flex; gap:24px; align-items:center; }
.redwood-juno-lockup img { height:32px; }
```
Uploading in 30m.
Alex (Partnerships): Timeline: get legal nod + partner confirmation by EOD tomorrow, design mockups for marketplace by EOD today, marketing to finalize hero blurb by tomorrow morning. If anyone can't hit these, flag here.
Dmitri (Marketing): I can do hero copy and the one-liner alt variations by 9am PT tomorrow.
Claire (Legal): I need the partner's license PDF and the benchmark doc. Otherwise I'll block the performance number in public text.
Priya (Design): Will post final mock images here when uploaded. :camera_with_flash:
Alex (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll ping Juno now for the benchmark docs and logo license. Also looping in partner PM after this thread. :rocket:
